poses.name: lounge-bottom
poses.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent desktop pet pose sprite. Reference image: the original Blue Whale blue-haired chibi maid, style and identity reference. Preserve her blue-to-cyan long hair, blue eyes, lace maid headband, cyan bows, navy maid dress, white apron with blue whale emblem, chibi proportions and exactly the same clean outlined softly shaded anime illustration style. Wholesome playful desktop pet, full body visible, actual transparent alpha, generous padding. No writing, labels, scenery, floor, shadows, extra characters or external hands. Create ONE full-body sprite of her leaning forward and resting her chin on both hands, elbows together on an invisible desktop ledge, soft half-lidded daydreaming face. Do not draw the table itself, it will be supplied by the app.
